_schema: lanes[]{id,title,summary,nodes[]{id,title,role (a few plain words, at most 40 characters),summary,files[],symbols[],review?},otherFiles[]}; edges[]{from,to} (from uses, creates or fills to); phases[]{id,title,summary}; flow[]{id,title ("N. Title", numbered in order),summary,overview,phase,condition?,files[],outputs[] (file names, not checked),docs[],branches[]{id,label,summary,default?},modes?{branchId: note; a step without a branch id is skipped in that mode},review?}; tasks[]{id,title,summary,audience,docs[],files[]}; startHere{map|flow|tasks: [{id,why}]}. Only one flow step has branches (the chemistry mode, in the first phase). Paths are repo-relative; a #fragment is allowed. Every file under src/ and header/ must appear in some node.files or lane.otherFiles.

lanes.title: Application entry
lanes.summary: Program start-up: wires the run manager, physics, actions and macro, then runs.

nodes.title: sim.cc
nodes.summary: The program's main(): parses the command line, picks Serial or multi-threaded running, builds the geometry, physics and actions, finds and executes the macro file, and flushes any pending output before exit.

lanes.title: Actions
lanes.summary: Per-run, per-event and per-track hooks that Geant4 calls while the simulation runs.

nodes.title: ActionInitialization
nodes.summary: Creates all the user actions for each thread and sets the default chemistry end time (1 s with the mesoscopic stage, 1 us without).

nodes.title: PrimaryGeneratorAction
nodes.summary: Shoots the primary beam particle (set by /gun macro commands) and records the sampled beam into the run.

nodes.title: Run and RunAction
nodes.summary: Run keeps per-run data and merges worker threads; RunAction starts and ends a run, applies the reaction time binning and records the run in the manifest.

nodes.title: EventAction
nodes.summary: Per-event bookkeeping: stages pre-chemical files and commits the track-length row for events that were not aborted.

nodes.title: TrackingAction
nodes.summary: After each track, fills the event's track-length row: primary track length and how it ended (stopped, escaped or killed), plus secondary-electron lengths.

nodes.title: SteppingAction
nodes.summary: Counts each discrete Geant4-DNA physical interaction (excluding transport) by process name.

nodes.title: StackingAction
nodes.summary: When the physical stage has no tracks left, starts the chemistry for the event (the hand-off from physics to chemistry) and logs the stage change.

lanes.title: Physics
lanes.summary: The physical stage: how electrons slow down and ionise water.

nodes.title: PhysicsList
nodes.summary: A simplified modular list that combines the Geant4-DNA electromagnetic physics (option 2) with the project's chemistry. IRT_syn is the default chemistry time-step model.

lanes.title: Geometry and environment
lanes.summary: The single homogeneous water box and the dissolved substances in it.

nodes.title: DetectorConstruction
nodes.summary: Builds the one water box (the whole geometry) and registers the PrimaryKiller scorer. Half-side set by /chem/env/halfBox (default 500 um).

nodes.title: DnaChemistryWorld
nodes.summary: Describes the chemical environment: box size, pH and exogenous scavengers (such as dissolved O2) that react through the selected Chemistry's bulk reactions.

nodes.title: Scavenger spec and messenger
nodes.summary: Parses /chem/env/scavenger values (M, mM, uM, or % for O2) into a validated specification.

lanes.title: Chemistry
lanes.summary: The chemical stages: what species exist, which reactions occur, and how time advances.

nodes.title: DnaChemistryList
nodes.summary: The driver of the chemical stage: defines the molecules, water dissociation channels, reaction table and time-step model (IRT_syn default, or SBS). Registers bulk reactions as scavenger processes.

nodes.title: TimeStepAction
nodes.summary: Runs the particle-based stage and, in IRT_syn with the mesoscopic stage on, hands the remaining molecules over at the Hand-over time to the mesoscopic stage (Gillespie on a cell mesh).

nodes.title: MesoSettings
nodes.summary: Portable settings for the mesoscopic stage: hand-over time, requested cell size, pixel count (capped) and the logarithmic recording time grid.

nodes.title: MesoMessenger
nodes.summary: Macro commands /chem/meso/* (enable, handOverTime, voxelSize, timesPerDecade, spatialOutput).

nodes.title: ChemistryRegistry
nodes.summary: Name-to-Chemistry registry and the once-per-process, case-insensitive selection.

nodes.title: ChemistrySelectMessenger
nodes.summary: Macro commands /chem/select <name> and /chem/list.

nodes.title: ReactionTableDump
nodes.summary: Writes the reaction table to a file (/chem/reaction/dump).

nodes.title: PureWater Chemistry
nodes.summary: The default Chemistry: base pure-water reactions, the O2-derived network and the pH-driven acid-base buffer.

nodes.title: BoscoloChem
nodes.summary: Chemistry reproducing Table 1 of Boscolo et al. 2020 (26 reactions).

nodes.title: Tonneau2025
nodes.summary: Chemistry with the 73-reaction network of Tonneau et al. 2025, including the extra molecule HO3.

nodes.title: Farokhi2023
nodes.summary: Chemistry with the 9 base-water reactions of Farokhi et al. 2023.

lanes.title: Scoring and output
lanes.summary: Everything that counts, accumulates and writes results.

nodes.title: ScoreSpecies
nodes.summary: A Geant4 primitive scorer that follows the tracked molecules over time; it is the source of the Species files.

nodes.title: ReactionCounter
nodes.summary: Counts how many times each reaction fires in each time bin (particle-based stage only).

nodes.title: PhysicsInteractionCounter
nodes.summary: Generic string-frequency counter used for physical-interaction counts.

nodes.title: MesoSpeciesCounter
nodes.summary: Mean species count per event versus time in the mesoscopic stage.

nodes.title: MesoSpatialFile
nodes.summary: HDF5 writer for per-event spatial snapshots of the mesoscopic mesh.

nodes.title: TrackLengthTable
nodes.summary: One row per event with the primary track length, end reason and secondary-electron lengths.

nodes.title: PrimaryKiller
nodes.summary: Scorer that kills the primary electron after a configured energy loss and kills tracks leaving a bounding box.

nodes.title: RunAccumulator
nodes.summary: Process-wide accumulator that keeps energy deposit, counters and run entries across /run/beamOn calls until a dump.

nodes.title: RunAccumulatorMessenger
nodes.summary: Provides /run/dumpDataAndReset and the exit-time safety-net flush.

nodes.title: RunManifest
nodes.summary: Builds Manifest.json for each dump (beam, seed, chemistry, environment, files).

nodes.title: DataNode and JsonWriter
nodes.summary: Portable output tree and the JSON serialiser that writes it.

nodes.title: PreChemicalFiles
nodes.summary: Moves the staged per-event pre-chemical files into a dump.

lanes.title: Core utilities
lanes.summary: Cross-cutting services: command line, output folder, logging, macro lookup.

nodes.title: ArgParser
nodes.summary: Parses the --threads and --dir command-line flags.

nodes.title: OutputDir
nodes.summary: The process-wide output directory (default results next to the executable) and filename prefix used by every output site.

nodes.title: DnaLogger
nodes.summary: The project's logger; level set by /dnaLogger/verbose.

nodes.title: MacroResolver
nodes.summary: Finds the macro: as given, then next to the executable, then in its macro/ folder.

lanes.title: Macros
lanes.summary: Runtime configuration: beam, chemistry and dumps.

nodes.title: Mode examples
nodes.summary: example_sbs.in, example_irt.in and example_meso.in: one macro per chemistry mode, 10 keV electrons, two sub-runs.

nodes.title: Beam examples
nodes.role: Pure water, O2 and spatial runs
nodes.summary: beam.in (pure water), beam_o2.in (dissolved O2), beam_meso_spatial.in (spatial output).

nodes.title: Chemistry examples
nodes.summary: beam_boscolo.in and beam_tonneau2025.in select other Chemistries.

lanes.title: Unit tests
lanes.summary: Plain-assert tests built by CMake and run with ctest from build-ninja.

nodes.title: Core and output tests
nodes.summary: Tests for argument parsing, output folder, macro lookup, JSON writing, results index and run accumulation.

nodes.title: Chemistry tests
nodes.summary: Tests for the registry, mesoscopic settings, reaction table dump, scavenger spec and the Tonneau2025 table.

nodes.title: Scoring tests
nodes.summary: Tests for counters, track lengths, spatial HDF5 file and pre-chemical files.

phases.title: Once, at start-up
phases.summary: The program is configured before any particle is shot.

phases.title: For every event
phases.summary: Repeated for each primary particle shot by /run/beamOn: the physical stage first, then the chemistry.

phases.title: When results are written
phases.summary: Data from all events accumulates until the macro asks for a dump, or the program exits.

flow.title: 1. Start-up
flow.summary: The program reads its command line (--threads, --dir), builds the geometry, physics and actions, and finds and runs the macro file that configures the beam and the chemistry.
flow.overview: Read the command line and run the macro that configures the simulation.

flow.title: 2. Chemistry mode
flow.summary: Chosen once, in the macro before /run/initialize: /process/chem/TimeStepModel (SBS or IRT_syn) and /chem/meso/enable. The choice then applies to every event. The selected Chemistry (reaction network) is independent of this choice.

branches.label: SBS
branches.summary: Step-by-step chemistry on tracked molecules up to the end time; no mesoscopic stage (/process/chem/TimeStepModel SBS).

branches.label: IRT_syn only
branches.summary: IRT_syn particle-based stage up to the end time; no mesoscopic stage (/chem/meso/enable false).

branches.label: IRT_syn + mesoscopic
branches.summary: IRT_syn particle-based stage, then a hand-over to the mesoscopic stage.

flow.overview: Chosen once in the macro: SBS, IRT_syn only, or IRT_syn + mesoscopic.

flow.title: 3. Physical stage
flow.summary: Beam electrons slow down in the water box and ionise or excite water molecules (Geant4-DNA physics). Every discrete physical interaction is counted, and the pre-chemical species are staged to a per-event file.
flow.overview: Beam electrons interact with water; physical interactions are counted.

flow.title: 4. Physics to chemistry
flow.summary: When the physical stage has no tracks left, the event's chemistry is started.
flow.overview: When no physical tracks remain, start the event’s chemistry.

flow.title: 5. Particle-based stage
flow.summary: Molecules are tracked individually; they diffuse and react. Species counts over time and reaction firings are recorded. In the default mode this stage stops at the Hand-over time (default 5 ns).
flow.overview: Track individual molecules as they diffuse and react.

modes.sbs: Step-by-step model up to the end time (default 1 us).
modes.irt: IRT_syn up to the end time (default 1 us).
modes.meso: IRT_syn until the Hand-over time (default 5 ns); step 6 continues.

flow.title: 6. Hand-over and mesoscopic stage
flow.summary: Only with IRT_syn and the mesoscopic stage enabled: the remaining molecules are passed to counts per cell on a mesh and advanced to the end time (default 1 s). Mean counts are recorded on a logarithmic time grid; optional per-event spatial snapshots.
flow.condition: Only in IRT_syn + mesoscopic mode (the default)
flow.overview: Pass remaining molecules to counts per cell and advance to the end time.

modes.meso: From the Hand-over time to the end time (default 1 s).

flow.title: 7. End of event
flow.summary: The primary track's length and how it ended are stored in one row per event.
flow.overview: Store the primary track’s length and how it ended.

flow.title: 8. Dump and manifest
flow.summary: Data accumulates over /run/beamOn calls. A /run/dumpDataAndReset command (or the exit-time safety net) writes all files together with Manifest.json, which records what produced them.
outputs: results index (Manifest.json in the output folder)
flow.overview: Write accumulated results and the manifest, then reset for the next dump.

modes.sbs: No SpeciesMeso files: the mesoscopic stage is off.
modes.irt: No SpeciesMeso files: the mesoscopic stage is off.
modes.meso: Also writes SpeciesMeso.Txt / .csv, and SpeciesMesoSpatial.h5 when /chem/meso/spatialOutput is true.
